entry.title: NCI R00 funded
entry.content:
Aug 2026

The Hegde lab participated in its first DMB Retreat held on campus !

Samarth also presented a Flash talk and the lab presented a poster at the annual Faculty Research Poster Sessions for new graduate students.

entry.title: NCI R00 funded
entry.content:
July 2026

The Hegde lab receives official NOA for NCI R00 on ‘Deconstructing pathogenic myelopoiesis in cancer immunosuppression and treatment resistance’. This pathway to independence award helps support our translation research on how myeloid cell expansion disrupts cancer therapies.

entry.title: Lab is active
entry.content:
July 2026

Hegde Lab opens in the Department of Developmental and Molecular Biology (DMB) at Albert Einstein College of Medicine. The Hegde Lab is also part of the Cancer Dormancy Institute (CDI) within the Montefiore Einstein Cancer Center.

entry.title: Lab at Keystone
entry.content:
Feb 2026

Samarth attended and presented a short talk on their recent Nature paper at the Keystone Symposia on Myeloid Cells: Functional Heterogeneity with Therapeutic Promise held jointly with Keystone Symposia on Hematopoiesis (Keystone, Colorado). For more insight on the conference, check out #KSMyeloid26 and #KSHemato26
